passage.label: those allying a people Allah angry with neither of you nor of them swearing to untruth knowingly; severe punishment prepared, evil what they were doing; took false oaths as cover averting from way of Allah, humiliating punishment; wealth and children never avail against Allah, companions of Fire abiding eternally; Day Allah resurrects them all and they swear to Him as they swear to you thinking they stand on something, they are the liars; Satan overcome them made them forget remembrance of Allah, party of Satan, they will be losers; those opposing Allah and His Messenger among most humbled; Allah has written I will surely overcome I and My messengers, Powerful Exalted Might; no people believing in Allah and Last Day having affection for those opposing Allah and His Messenger even fathers sons brothers kindred, He decreed faith within their hearts and supported them with spirit from Him, admitted to gardens beneath rivers flowing abiding eternally, Allah pleased with them and they pleased with Him, party of Allah, they are the successful

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوۡاْ قَوۡمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمۡ وَلَا مِنۡهُمۡ وَيَحۡلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡكَذِبِ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
لَّن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـًٔاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
يَوۡمَ يَبۡعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعٗا فَيَحۡلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحۡلِفُونَ لَكُمۡ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٍۚ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡكَٰذِبُونَ
ٱسۡتَحۡوَذَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ فَأَنسَىٰهُمۡ ذِكۡرَ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ فِي ٱلۡأَذَلِّينَ
كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَغۡلِبَنَّ أَنَا۠ وَرُسُلِيٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٞ

لَّا تَجِدُ قَوۡمٗا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنۡ حَآدَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ أَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ أَوۡ إِخۡوَٰنَهُمۡ أَوۡ عَشِيرَتَهُمۡۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٖ مِّنۡهُۖ وَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ رَضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ حِزۡبُ ٱللَّهِۚ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزۡبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

mainSubject.label: Alliance with a people under divine anger exposed as belonging to neither side, sealed by knowing false oaths and severe punishment for evil conduct; oaths used as cover to avert from Allah's way earning humiliation, with wealth and children useless against Him and eternal Fire awaiting; at resurrection they swear to Allah as they swore to the believers, imagining a standing they lack, named liars; Satan's mastery making them forget remembrance identifies them as the party of Satan destined to lose; opponents of Allah and His Messenger placed among the most humbled against the written decree that Allah and His messengers will prevail; genuine believers shown incapable of affection for Allah's opponents even among fathers, sons, brothers or kindred, faith inscribed in their hearts and supported by a spirit from Him, admitted to eternal rivered gardens with mutual pleasure — the party of Allah who are the successful

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the zihar expiation ladder and divine limits (4) before the opposition-and-abasement block opens (5); P2 ends with the Satanic-whispering diagnosis and reliance command (10) before assembly etiquette begins (11); P3 covers assembly conduct and the consultation-charity rule with its concession (11-13); P4 runs from the false-alliance critique through the two parties to the closing success declaration (14-22).
